Baseline overview error ledger inherits the prior preview mode transitions (#17567); fresh overview After run has its own error ledger.

Representative live evidence covers Local standalone Canvas in Neutral, Light+ and DeepSea, plus the recorded viewport cases. No all-five-theme, authenticated Cloud, ACP or arbitrary embedded-host visual pass is claimed.
